title: BREATHE — Self-Improving Agent Cycle
description: The autonomous improvement loop. Baseline scores, read state, evaluate priorities, act on highest-impact items, test changes, harvest deltas, evolve skills. Each breath feeds the next.
earned_from: Synthesis of all existing tools — heat map, pipeline scorer, garden listener, release gates, LOD system, ada-researcher cycle, session-handoff flow — into a single composable loop.

nodes.label: B — Baseline: snapshot all scores
nodes.detail: Run sequence_pipeline_scorer.py, heat_map_generator.py, garden_listener.py --diagnosis, run_release_gates.py. Save to doc/reports/breath_baseline_{timestamp}.json.

nodes.label: R — Read: perceive project state
nodes.detail: Load HEAT_MAP.json, FOCUS_VECTOR.json, LOD_TREE.json, breath_log.json. Extract cooling filter (failed items from last 2 breaths) and trajectory.

nodes.label: E — Evaluate: what to work on?
nodes.detail: Priority: 1) FOCUS_VECTOR primary, 2) temp 90+ blocked, 3) highest temperature*impact_score, 4) pipeline HEAD. Apply cooling filter. Select up to 5 items.

nodes.label: Dry-run: output work plan and stop
A — Act: dispatch to skills
nodes.detail: For each item: write THOUGHT block (2+ options + do nothing), then dispatch. Maps→map-expert, artifacts→artifact-improver, docs→code-documenter, text→humanizer, VR feedback→bridge-listener.

nodes.label: T — Test: validate every change
nodes.detail: Match change type to validator: map→pathfinder, sequence→verify_sequence, GDScript→Godot parse, registry→JSON parse, all→release gates. Failed items get reverted and marked.

nodes.label: H — Harvest: compute deltas, record outcomes
nodes.detail: Re-run pipeline_scorer. Compute delta vs baseline. Append to breath_log.json with items attempted/succeeded/failed, skills used, discoveries. Update improvement_trajectory.json.

nodes.label: E — Evolve: improve how we improve
nodes.detail: Level 1: Save new effective tool sequences as flows (autonomous). Level 2: Track skill effectiveness in trajectory (autonomous). Level 3: Propose SKILL.md changes to skill_evolution_proposals.json (human reviews).

nodes.label: Breath complete — project improved, knowledge recorded, next breath is smarter

summary: Baseline → Read → Evaluate → Act → Test → Harvest → Evolve. Each breath feeds the next via breath_log.json. 5-item cap, cooling filter, FOCUS_VECTOR priority, 3-tier safety.
